decisions.reason: The 15-day express program is cheap to maintain and fits the fast-delivery promise, but it overlaps with the broader express line D, so consolidation is a real possibility even though slack in a growing firm lets it continue for now.
The 72-hour service supports the firm's rapid-response positioning, yet it appears only as a website mention and could be folded into line D, so it stays with an elevated risk of being dropped.
The European-approved fire-resistant exterior door extends the core Teckentrup 62 modular system and likely meets aspirations, so there is no shortfall that would trigger search.
The multi-model express line has its own page, anchors the firm's fast-delivery offer and likely absorbs the smaller express programs, so it performs at or above aspiration.
The digital ordering and service platform matches the firm's strategic move toward deeper service support, and organisational slack allows it to be carried while its returns mature.
